notes.紫微: Steady outwardly, but deeply concerned with respect; you tend to hold important people and matters tightly. A natural ability to decide shows most with help at hand, and listening to others now and then smooths the way.
notes.天机: Full of ideas and quick to react, skilled at planning and analysis. Thinking finely also means thinking long; going deep on one chosen thing is steadier than constantly switching.
notes.太阳: Open and warm, willing to say things clearly and to look after others. A blunt streak can be hard to take; leave some room and don't burn yourself dry.
notes.武曲: Ready to act, loyal, and able to carry burdens. Quick decisions can turn into a one-way track; one more opinion often saves a detour.
notes.天同: Easygoing and pleasant, with a little childlike softness left inside. Not quick to push yourself; a small goal is enough to get moving.
notes.廉贞: Clear in love and dislike, direct in speech, with an unyielding streak. Give yourself a buffer when emotions rise and hold your boundaries; life gets clearer.
notes.天府: Steady and capable, with a strong sense of face. Fiddly details wear your patience; a compatible partner to fill that gap makes it easier.
notes.太阴: Sensitive and attentive, noticing many small details. Prone to overthinking; saying what matters lightly is more comfortable than keeping it in.
notes.贪狼: Wide interests and a knack for things; you want to try a bit of everything. Going deep on one thing you truly love is more satisfying than skimming many.
notes.巨门: Skilled at asking and debating, with a fine mind. Words flying back and forth easily cause misunderstanding; pause half a beat and jot down what matters.
notes.天相: Gentle and thorough, the best at smoothing things over. A soft heart can follow others too easily; keep one opinion of your own and find a partner who can decide.
notes.天梁: Mature and principled, naturally inclined to look after people. Too much caring tires you; return others' issues to them and you can breathe too.
notes.七杀: Independent and decisive, willing to carry things yourself. Impatience shows on your face; tempering it puts your drive to better use.
notes.破军: Bold in tearing down and rebuilding, with strong opinions. Pave a short stretch of the new road and keep a way out before acting; the pioneering energy then lands.
